name: theme-arcade
title: Arcade theme
description: The arcade look: gradient surfaces, a heavy dark outline on every control, circular player identity, and an uppercase Bungee display face. Install it, then set data-gs-theme="arcade" on the root. It brings its own typeface, which is the part a theme cannot do on its own.
docs: Import gamestage-theme-arcade.css after gamestage-tokens.css, and set data-gs-theme="arcade" on <html> or on any subtree. The theme is a cascade layer rather than a specificity trick, so it wins over the light and dark context whatever the selectors look like. Everything it does not name it inherits from the base tokens. Axes it changes: colour, shape.identity, stroke.control, the action type and the display typeface.
